200.description: Provider authorize URL; sets the signed state cookie.

get.description: Who: anyone. Browser navigation. Failures redirect to /sign-in?error=<code>, code one of validation_failed, forbidden, unauthenticated, rate_limited, no_membership.

302.description: Redirect; sets the session cookie on success.

202.description: Accepted, no body; also returned for unknown or not-allowed emails.

200.description: Tiny HTML page with one button that POSTs to the same URL; does not consume the token (guards against link scanners).

post.description: Who: anyone. Browser form post. Failures redirect to /sign-in?error=<code>, code one of validation_failed, forbidden, unauthenticated, rate_limited, no_membership.

302.description: Redirect; sets the session cookie on success.

204.description: Signed out; idempotent, clears the cookie.

delete.description: Who: admin. 409 when the department still has courses or department admins.

post.description: Who: admin. 409 when the term name already exists.

patch.description: Who: admin. 409 when the term name already exists.

delete.description: Who: admin. 409 when the term still has sections.

get.description: Who: admin; dept_admin for member invitations only.

post.description: Who: admin; dept_admin for member invitations only.

delete.description: Who: admin; dept_admin for member invitations only. 409 if already accepted.

patch.description: Who: admin. 409 when demoting the last admin.

delete.description: Who: admin. 409 for the last admin.

get.description: Who: member. Every active member reads the catalog (D37). Filters: departmentId, q (code or title); combined with AND.

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). 409 when the course still has sections.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required departmentCode, code, title. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "code is required", "title is required", "code must be at most 20 characters", "title must be at most 200 characters", "unknown department code <X>", "department <X> is not managed by you". Existing rows are never updated.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required departmentCode, code, title. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "code is required", "title is required", "code must be at most 20 characters", "title must be at most 200 characters", "unknown department code <X>", "department <X> is not managed by you". Existing rows are never updated.

get.description: Who: member. Every active member reads every section of the university (D37). pendingStaff is [] for plain members. Filters: termId, courseId, departmentId (the course's department), q (course code or title); all combine with AND.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). meetings is optional, at most 20 rows (400 field meetings); per row errors use field meetings[<i>].weekday, .startsAt, .endsAt, .location (0-based, in the order sent), e.g. "must be after startsAt".

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). meetings, when present, replaces the whole list; [] clears it; omitted (or null) keeps it. Validation as on create.

get.description: Who: member. Any active member reads a section; rosters stay staff-only. pendingStaff is [] for a plain member who is not staff on the section.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required courseCode, termName, number; optional instructorEmails, taEmails (semicolon-separated), meetings (semicolon-separated slots "Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101"; weekday Mon..Sun, case-insensitive; 24-hour HH:MM; "@ location" optional). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "number is required", "number must be at most 20 characters", "unknown course code <X>", "unknown term <X>", "course <X> is not in a department you manage", "invalid email <raw>", "<email> listed as both instructor and ta", "<email>: membership is not active", "meeting \"<slot>\" must look like Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101", "meeting \"<slot>\": unknown weekday <X>", "meeting \"<slot>\": <field> <message>", "at most 20 meetings". An existing section is never changed; instructors, TAs and invitations missing from it are added (action add/invite, message "section exists; adds staff"); listed staff keep their current role. Meetings are written for a new section, or an existing one that has none (message "section exists; adds meetings"); an existing section's meetings are never changed (message "section exists; keeps meetings").

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required courseCode, termName, number; optional instructorEmails, taEmails (semicolon-separated), meetings (semicolon-separated slots "Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101"; weekday Mon..Sun, case-insensitive; 24-hour HH:MM; "@ location" optional). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "number is required", "number must be at most 20 characters", "unknown course code <X>", "unknown term <X>", "course <X> is not in a department you manage", "invalid email <raw>", "<email> listed as both instructor and ta", "<email>: membership is not active", "meeting \"<slot>\" must look like Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101", "meeting \"<slot>\": unknown weekday <X>", "meeting \"<slot>\": <field> <message>", "at most 20 meetings". An existing section is never changed; instructors, TAs and invitations missing from it are added (action add/invite, message "section exists; adds staff"); listed staff keep their current role. Meetings are written for a new section, or an existing one that has none (message "section exists; adds meetings"); an existing section's meetings are never changed (message "section exists; keeps meetings").

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin of the course's department, staff and enrolled members. Accepted staff only; invited staff are in Section.pendingStaff.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin; instructor of the section for ta rows. Instructors may only send role ta. 409: already staff; invitation already pending for this section; user is already a member (invited membership).

202.description: Email has no active membership; invitation created

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin; instructor of the section for ta rows.

Who: admin, dept_admin; instructor of the section for ta rows. Deletes only the pending row for this section; the invitation stays (revoke it with deleteInvitation). 404 when the invitation has no pending row on this section.

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin; staff of the section (instructors and TAs).

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email; optional displayName. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. displayName is accepted and ignored. Row messages: "invalid email", "membership is not active", "domain not allowed".

Who: admin, dept_admin. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email; optional displayName. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. displayName is accepted and ignored. Row messages: "invalid email", "membership is not active", "domain not allowed".

departmentIds.description: Must be non-empty iff role is dept_admin (else 400 field departmentIds); unknown id is 404.

actor.description: Omitted when the row has no actor (platform CLI).

PendingStaff.description: Staff invited by email who have not signed in yet.

Meeting.description: One weekly slot; wall-clock time in the university's timezone.

MeetingInput.description: endsAt must be after startsAt. Location is trimmed; omitted means "".

pendingStaff.description: Invitees not signed in yet. [] for callers who may not see them: plain members on GET /sections; plain members who are not staff on the section on GET /sections/{id}; student rows of /me/sections.

meetings.description: The section's weekly meetings; omitted means none.
When present, replaces the whole list ([] clears). Omitted keeps the current meetings.

next.description: Relative path to return to after sign-in; anything else is ignored.

OidcStart.description: Send exactly one of slug or email (else 400 field slug).

next.description: Relative path to return to after sign-in; anything else is ignored.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Values below 1 mean 50, above 200 mean 200 (clamped by ParsePage); non-integer is 400 field limit.

q.name: q
q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the course code or title. Blank means no filter; over 100 characters is 400 field q.
